subject: Synthesis: Discovery -> POV playbook & onramp (HighTide)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Donna Park <donna@hightide.ai>, Alex Mercer <alex@hightide.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Synthesis: Discovery -> POV playbook & onramp (HighTide)

Donna / Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick synthesis and a proposed playbook to get a POV kicked off that validates the three use cases you described. I want to surface assumptions, owners, and the minimal access we'll need to start.

High-level pain/gaps we heard
- Prediction latency: customer-facing API currently ~1.2s P95, intermittent spikes to 2.5s.
- Unit cost pressure: token and infra cost are limiting per-user feature expansion.
- Retrieval/knowledge freshness: content sync takes ~24-48h, impacting answer accuracy.
- Security/egress: legal needs clarity on egress for third-party model hosting.

Goals for the POV (what success looks like)
- Latency: reduce P95 latency by >=40% on the canonical query set (target P95 <= 0.8s).
- Cost: measured tokens-per-dollar improvement of >=25% vs current baseline.
- Quality: maintain or improve accuracy on your 120-item eval set (prompt-set attached).
- Operational: validate end-to-end access patterns (S3 -> Redwood Private), confirm telemetry and tracing.

Proposed scope (4 weeks, trimmed option below)
Week 0 (pre-work): access, sample data, baseline metrics collection (we'll do a quick script to collect P50/P95).
Week 1: model & infra choices, deploy two candidate model variants, run synthetic load and latency profiling.
Week 2: integrate retrieval pipeline, run prompt-set evals, gather cost estimates.
Week 3: joint acceptance run, handover doc, and recommendations (quantization / batching configs).

Owners
- HighTide: Donna Park (PM), Alex Mercer (Engineering lead)
- Redwood: Dylan Brooks (AE / engagement lead), Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer), Marissa Cole (Customer Success)

Access checklist (what we need from HighTide)
- Sample dataset (S3 path or pre-signed URLs) — small subset of representative docs.
- Short-lived service account or role for read-only S3 access.
- Allowlist IPs for Private deployment or VPC peering details if you prefer.
- Security contact for SOC2 / egress Qs.

Attachments: POV-playbook-HT-v1.pdf (stub), mutual-action-plan-HT.xlsx (stub), prompt-set-v1.csv (prompt eval set)

Immediate ask / next steps (please reply with):
1) Confirm owners above or propose alternates.
2) Confirm S3 access method and whether we should request a pre-signed URL or set up IAM role.
3) Any timeline constraints (we've proposed 4 weeks; we can compress to 3 if needed).

I'll stand up the baseline collection script and post a short guide to the Drive folder once we have access. Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Donna Park <donna@hightide.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex@hightide.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-06T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synthesis: Discovery -> POV playbook & onramp (HighTide)

Thanks Dylan — solid summary and appreciate the clear owners. A few quick notes from our side:
- Timeline: we'd prefer to compress to a 3-week POV if possible — product roadmap has a hard gating decision on 3/29.
- Data/egress: legal flagged that any outbound model hosting must have a clear egress report and no persistent storage outside our account; can you confirm Redwood Private (VPC) option meets that?
- Prompt set: I'll take a pass on the attached prompt-set and add 20 edge-case queries by Friday.

I'll ask Alex to coordinate the engineering access (S3 details) and we'll confirm a security contact. For owners, Donna/Alex as listed are good.

—Donna Park
Product Lead, HighTide Analytics
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Donna Park <donna@hightide.ai>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex@hightide.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synthesis: Discovery -> POV playbook & onramp (HighTide)

Donna — thanks. We can compress to a 3-week plan with an adjusted scope: combine profiling + retrieval integration in parallel and shorten the acceptance window to a rolling 48-72h run. Updated sketch:
- Week 0 (3 business days): access + baseline collection (we'll need S3 small sample and a contact for access).
- Week 1: model variants deployment + synthetic latency profiling.
- Week 2: retrieval integration + prompt-set evals + joint acceptance run.

Security: Redwood Private deployed into your VPC (or peered VPC) satisfies the egress requirement — no model weights or inference logs leave your network unless you explicitly enable an export. I'll loop in our Security PM for a short Q&A; can you share the legal/security contact so we can schedule a 30-minute review?

I've attached prompt-set-v1.csv (stub) and uploaded a draft POV-playbook to the Drive link in the metadata. I will also create a HubSpot record and attach the mutual action plan; HubSpot link is in the metadata.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Alex: please share the S3 path or confirm you'd like pre-signed URLs.
- Donna: confirm security contact and whether your legal needs a BAA (we can discuss).
- All: confirm that the 3-week cadence works and we'll publish a day-by-day checklist.

If that's all good, I'll schedule the kickoff tomorrow to get the baseline script running.

Best,
Dylan
From: Alex Mercer <alex@hightide.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Donna Park <donna@hightide.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synthesis: Discovery -> POV playbook & onramp (HighTide)

Dylan — quick note from engineering: we'll provide a pre-signed S3 URL for the sample subset by EOD today. Bucket is in us-west-2; object names will be under s3://ht-samples/pov/2026-03/. Regarding egress: we'll want the security call but confirm that VPC peering + no outbound NAT is the preference.

We'll be available for a 30-min kickoff tomorrow at 10am PT if that works for Redwood.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Engineering Lead, HighTide Analytics
